title: Halden & Co.: how expenses are handled, as the finance team keeps it

tasks.name: Process the pending expenses
tasks.summary: Decide every expense that is waiting, and tell the person who asked what was decided.
tasks.input: The pending expenses the expense system lists (list_pending); each expense's details come from get_expense. A request to process the queue, to handle what is pending, or the like, is this task.
tasks.done: Every expense that was pending has a decision recorded in the expense system, and the person who asked has been told what was decided and anything they should know.
tasks.failed: An expense is left pending without a reason; a decision is recorded that rests on no rule you can name; or the report says something that is not so.
quality: Correct before fast: a decision is final once it is recorded.
A decision rests on the rules in force — the domain model as you can read it now — and not on what you remember of them.
The report is honest about your own work: it names the expenses, and says which decisions you are unsure of and which you know or suspect were wrong.
tasks.mandate: You decide alone, expense by expense: approve, reject, or escalate to the role the rules name. You do not change a rule, you do not decide what the rules assign to another role, and you do not carry out anything that is not a decision on a pending expense.
tasks.scope: Pending expenses in the expense system. A request about anything else is outside this task: say so, and say what you can do instead.

plans.name: Check an expense against the others before you decide it
plans.when: You are about to decide an expense, and there are other expenses, pending or already decided, in this piece of work.
steps: Compare the expense with the others — those still pending and those you have decided — using what the domain model says makes one expense a duplicate of another.
If it is one, decide it as the rules say for a duplicate; the order in which you meet the two does not matter.
plans.why: The expense system does not mark a duplicate: only a comparison finds it, and an expense decided before it is compared cannot be taken back.
plans.adapt: How you compare is yours — a note, the pending list, get_expense on the candidates. In a queue of one there is nothing to compare.

plans.name: One way through a queue
plans.when: You have been asked to process what is pending.
steps: List what is pending, and read each expense's details.
For each expense, read the rules for its category in the domain model, at the version in force.
Decide it, and note the decision with the rule it rests on.
When nothing is pending, report (see 'Tell your reader what was decided').
plans.why: A sequence that takes the task from request to report; an illustration, not the only one.
plans.adapt: Any order; one expense at a time or several; any record that serves you.
